name: E-commerce & Retail
org_structure_note: Fast-paced. Seasonal peaks (Black Friday, Singles Day). Strong integration between marketing and operations.
funding_stages: Seed → Series A → (unit economics focus) → B → C → IPO

regional_notes.na: Amazon dominated. Shopify ecosystem. D2C boom. Stripe/Shopify Payments standard.
regional_notes.emea: Cross-border EU commerce. Marketplace regulation (DMA). UK independent. Different payment preferences.
regional_notes.apac: Alibaba/JD (China). Shopee/Lazada (SEA). Rakuten (Japan). Coupang (Korea). Flipkart/Meesho (India). Social commerce huge.
regional_notes.latam: MercadoLibre dominates. Magalu, B2W. Social commerce via WhatsApp/Instagram. Cash payments still significant.
